# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 18 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 18
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. The way of light is this: if anyone wishes to make his way to the appointed place, he must be diligent in his works. The knowledge that has been given to us for walking in this way is as follows:
2. You shall love your maker; you shall fear your creator; you shall glorify him who redeemed you from death. You shall be simple in heart and rich in spirit. You shall not attach yourself to those who walk the way of death. You shall hate everything that is not pleasing to God; you shall hate all hypocrisy. You shall not abandon the commandments of the Lord.
3. You shall not exalt yourself but shall be humble in all things. You shall not take honor to yourself. You shall not entertain a wicked plan against your neighbor. You shall not give your soul over to arrogance.
4. You shall not commit fornication, nor adultery, nor corrupt children. The word of God shall not go out from you to any in their uncleanness. You shall not show partiality when you rebuke anyone for a transgression. You shall be meek; you shall be quiet; you shall tremble at the words you have heard.
5. You shall not hold a grudge against your brother. You shall not be in two minds about whether a thing shall happen or not. You shall not take the name of the Lord in vain. You shall love your neighbor more than your own soul. You shall not destroy a child by abortion, and you shall not kill the newborn. You shall not withhold your hand from your son or your daughter, but from their youth you shall teach them the fear of God.
6. You shall not covet your neighbor's possessions; you shall not be avaricious. You shall not join yourself to the arrogant but shall walk with the humble and righteous. You shall receive whatever befalls you as a good thing, knowing that nothing happens apart from God.
7. You shall not be double-tongued or double-minded; for a double tongue is a snare of death. You shall be subject to the Lord and to human lords as to an image of God, with reverence and fear.
8. Whatever commandments are laid upon you, keep them, neither adding to them nor taking from them.
